intro: Belize is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state.

chapters.title: How it works
text: King Charles III is head of state, represented by a governor-general. The prime minister leads the government; Johnny Briceño won a second term in 2025.

chapters.title: Border dispute
text: Guatemala's claim to Belize is being decided by the International Court of Justice.

keyTerms.meaning: A country sharing the British monarch.
